name: dev-ledger-unsupported-schema-version
expected_reason: Dev ledger `schema_version != 2`: the Dev validator fails the record with `schema_version must be 2` (dev_state.py l.156–159). This discriminator is the Dev ledger schema, not a *-v1 interface version, and it is distinct from `completion-result-v1` `profile_version`, where a missing/unknown value is `unknown`, not invalid (D4.5 l.445).
